answer: Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The ember graph is validated at intake and the walnut frontier is published, and therefore the ancestry of every answer is public, and ripple anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1547 impostors cost 1683 times the honest price and take 27 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
